title: Parametric desktop shelf
description: A 160 × 65 mm desktop shelf with two supports, linked sketch planes and a filleted upper shelf.
tryThis: Open Variables and edit width (120, 160 or 200 mm), depth, clearance or wall. Save each size as a design variant. Move the lower shelf in Z to see the linked parts follow.

title: Control panel workshop: make it fit your next project
description: A 3 mm faceplate with a centered display opening, independently sized button and mounting holes, mirrored shoulders, and a sliding cable slot. A separate bezel and button trim ring complete the workshop. Numbered notes inside the design explain each edit.
tryThis: Open the panel sketch and follow the numbered notes. Widen the display from 48 to 56 mm, reshape either shoulder, then slide the cable slot. Edit the separate bezel and trim ring in their own sketches; they are not linked across bodies.

title: Mounting plate: resize without remeasuring
description: An 80 × 50 mm plate with two 6 mm mounting holes. The holes stay 50 mm apart, centered left-to-right, while the plate width changes.
tryThis: Double-click the plate. Select the 80 mm bottom-edge badge and change it to 110 mm. Both holes remain centered as the plate grows.

title: Spacer ring: change the fit, keep the wall
description: A 40 mm opening surrounded by a 3 mm radial wall. Adapt a bezel or spacer to a different opening without calculating two diameters.
tryThis: Double-click the ring. Change the inner diameter from 40 to 48 mm: the outside grows to 54 mm. Then try a 4 mm radial gap.

title: Custom label: a border that follows your outline
description: A clipped-corner label outline with a 3 mm rounded border. Reshape the label and the outer rim follows automatically.
tryThis: Double-click the border. Drag the rightmost source corner, then open the offset badge and change its distance from 3 to 5 mm.

title: Picture-hanger plate: reshape one side, match both
description: A symmetric outline for a picture-hanger mounting plate, with two 5 mm holes on its centerline. Adjust the shoulders or tapered top without rebuilding the other side.
tryThis: Double-click the plate. Drag a right-hand corner outward: the matching left corner follows. Try dragging the left side too. Delete the Symmetry relationship to edit the sides independently.

title: A plate that keeps its dimensions
description: Resize a connected rectangular plate while keeping its sides horizontal and vertical.
tryThis: Edit the 80 mm width constraint, then move a corner.

title: An adjustable ring
description: Keep two circles centered together with a controlled radial gap.
tryThis: Change the 6 mm radial gap or the 30 mm inner diameter.

title: A centered tab and sliding guide
description: One tab stays at the rail midpoint; another attachment can slide along it.
tryThis: Move either rail endpoint, then drag the sliding attachment along the rail.

title: Matching sides that move together
description: Two line segments share a persistent reflection relationship around a construction axis.
tryThis: Move an endpoint on either side, or rotate the construction axis.

title: A rim that follows its outline
description: An outer border follows edits to its connected source profile.
tryThis: Move a source corner, then change the offset distance or corner style.
